secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the GanjaGuru AI chat feature. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Without it, the AI chat returns a 'not configured' message but the rest of the site works.

secrets.name: OPENAI_MODEL
secrets.description: OpenAI model name for GanjaGuru (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Optional — defaults to gpt-4o-mini.
